notes: Read SKILL.md in full; it is the only file. Kustomize guide: base/overlay layout, strategic-merge, JSON and inline patches, ConfigMap/Secret generators, image and name transformations, components, remote resources, helmCharts integration, replacements, and common issues.

Most content is YAML the agent may write into the user's repo. The Commands section (SKILL.md:354-372) shows kubectl apply -k, kubectl delete -k overlays/production, and kustomize build | kubectl apply against the current cluster. Medium because these apply or delete cluster resources; acceptable because they are a standard command reference, with kubectl kustomize/diff shown for preview and best practices advising to test builds before applying. Users should confirm before any delete -k, especially on a production overlay.

Remote resources (SKILL.md:346-349) pull manifests from GitHub URLs, one pinned to ?ref=v1.0.0 and one to a main branch; the skill advises pinning. The secretGenerator literal 'api-key=secret123' is a placeholder. Related Skills (SKILL.md:452-454) link to sibling skills (../kubernetes-ops/, ../helm-charts/, ../argocd-gitops/) that do not ship with this skill; optional. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
